claims.evidence: The photos show a Sigma zoom lens, but the exact model (12-24mm) and Canon compatibility are not clearly readable.

claims.evidence: Photos only; no functional test shown (focus/zoom smoothness, AF, aperture behavior).

risks.risk: Wrong lens model/range (seller says Sigma 12-24mm, but the model text is not clearly readable).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the lens barrel text showing the exact model (e.g., “12-24mm”) and mount marking (Canon EF).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Sigma zoom lens of unknown exact model/condition (worst case within the provided comparables).

risks.risk: Mount compatibility mismatch (Canon vs other mounts).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear mount contacts/label showing Canon EF fitment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed for Canon (worst case: treat as lower-value/less desirable until confirmed).

risks.risk: Hidden fungus/haze/scratches on internal elements not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Seller shows the lens under strong light at multiple angles (front + rear element) and a quick wipe test/inspection video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed clean (worst case: assume possible wear and discount accordingly).

risks.risk: AF/zoom/aperture performance issues (seller claims perfect working condition).
risks.proof: Video of zooming through the full range + autofocus test on a Canon body (or aperture test) with sound/visible focus changes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until demonstrated (worst case).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the lens barrel text showing the exact Sigma model (confirm “12-24mm”) and the mount type (Canon EF).
Close-up photo of the rear mount (contacts + any Canon marking).
Video showing zoom from wide to tele end + autofocus test on a Canon camera (or at least aperture actuation).
Front and rear element inspection under bright light from multiple angles to rule out fungus/haze/scratches.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Sigma zoom lens, but the exact model (12-24mm) and Canon compatibility are not readable, and key condition claims (fungus/scratches, working performance) are not provable from the images alone. Without that, a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct comparable.
